text:
Aisha (newhire): Hey team — day 1 and I'm stuck. I installed the VPN client and got an IP (10.8.3.45) but can't SSH to our bastion (bastion.redwood.internal). `ssh` just times out from my Windows laptop. I followed the installer steps at https://redwood.internal/docs/vpn-setup. Anyone seen this with home ISPs like Starlink?

Ben (infra): Welcome Aisha! You shouldn't normally need to allowlist a home IP. Quick checks: are you using WSL2, Git Bash, or native Windows OpenSSH? Can you paste the last lines of `ssh -vvv aisha@bastion.redwood.internal`?

Aisha (newhire): Using native OpenSSH in PowerShell. Last lines: `debug1: connect to address 10.12.0.3 port 22: Connection timed out`.

DevOps Bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4872 - VPN tunnel health check for user Aisha. Assigned to Ben.

Carlos (sre): @Ben +1 — that looks like traffic isn't routing to the VPC. Starlink and some consumer ISPs do weird NAT or block routes that break split-tunnel setups. Can you run `ping 10.12.0.3` and `tracert 10.12.0.3` in PowerShell and paste outputs?

Aisha (newhire): `ping` times out. `tracert` shows it stops at my home gateway, never reaches our edge. Public sites are reachable (I can hit https://status.redwood.ai).

Monica (eng-mgr): Hi Aisha, welcome! If we can't get the split-tunnel route working quickly we can give you temporary access via AWS Session Manager so you can SSM into the bastion instance without direct SSH. @Ben is that safe for Day 1?

Ben (infra): Yes — SSM is fine for onboarding. Short term troubleshooting: try switching to the `redwood-full` VPN profile instead of the default `redwood-split`. That forces all traffic through the VPN and usually bypasses ISP-level routing issues. Settings -> Network -> disable split-tunnel in the client also works. I just added you to `redwood-full` for 24h.

Aisha (newhire): Where is the `redwood-full` profile? The installer only showed one profile earlier.

Ben (infra): It's in the Console under VPN Profiles: https://redwood.internal/console/vpn-profiles. You should now see `redwood-full` in the client after a reconnect. I also refreshed your cert.

Aisha (newhire): Reconnected with `redwood-full` and... success! SSH now hits the bastion prompt: `aisha@bastion:~$`. Thank you :tada:

Carlos (sre): Nice. We'll keep INFRA-4872 open for a short while to monitor if this recurs. Long-term we may add a note to the Windows instructions about consumer ISPs and split-tunnel. Also we'll provision Session Manager for you so future day-1s won't need to rely on home SSH.

Aisha (newhire): Filled the quick access form: https://redwood.internal/forms/onboarding-network — requested SSM + permanent `redwood-full` access for my corp laptop. Also happy to PR the Windows doc change about Starlink notes.

Monica (eng-mgr): Please do the doc PR — great catch. Welcome aboard again :wave:

Ben (infra): INFRA-4872 marked resolved for now. If you see flaky connectivity later, ping #eng-infra or DM me directly and we'll re-open.
